notes: Every request requires a non-empty text item.
T2VA requires an explicit non-adaptive ratio.
I2VA/FL2VA ratio follows input keyframe and is treated as adaptive.
Ref2VA may use adaptive or explicit supported ratio.
Output: 24 FPS + 32kHz stereo audio per official H3 system spec.
Stable dialogue languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish; others vary.
Hosted V2 cannot mix first_frame/last_frame with reference_image/reference_video/reference_audio in one generation request.

bestFor: draft generation without raw multimodal references
knownRisks: Do not choose for reference-heavy production ads.

notes: FL2VA generally prefers a single continuous shot unless cuts are explicit.
H3-Max has no Ref2VA continuation path.
